question: What is this slight shimmer that belongs to the ocean of awakening?
premises: only a slight movement is this much shining
this wave belongs to the ocean of awakening
it is never there without this consciousness
inference: the wave of awakening shines only as non-other consciousness
uncertainties: ananyasphuraṇa taken as 'shining as nothing other'
plain_english: This slight stirring, this shimmer of nothing else, is the wave on the ocean of awakening, never present without consciousness.
